reviews.title: Awesome case
reviews.comment: This case makes it easy to build your new computer. I liked the thoughtful placement of every part like wiring that feeds to the back, or drive placement. Very well designed and manufactured case.
reviews.author: Mike

reviews.title: Plenty of space to hide extra power cables.
reviews.comment: Nice looking case.  I like the drawer in the bottom of the case. Easy to install Blu-ray burner. My friend plans on getting this case for his new build.
reviews.author: David P Walker

reviews.title: Absolu amazing! Fractal is the best!
reviews.comment: 4 years ago I built my pc with a Fractal Torrent Mini and I was really impressed. I have built many pcs and have never seen this level of though put into a case. That is why 2 years later when we were planning to build another pc fory gf, my immediate go to was fractal. We bough this case, she has been using it for 2 years and no issues, easy to build into. Definitely value for money if you are building for the first time as it makes it way easier to build.
reviews.author: Gokalpcetin

reviews.title: Decent PC case, could use more fan slots, but strong all around option
reviews.comment: This is a solid PC case, only problem is that after a few months I'm noticing dust build up on the inside even with positive air pressure. Dust does build up on the outside frequently so that's a good sign that it's catching a good part of the dust, but don't expect this to catch all dust. Pretty room in that I was able to install all the components I needed even with a somewhat big GPU. It looks sleek and has a good aesthetic. Only downside I would have with this is that it would be nice to have more fan slots, but those fan slots wouldn't be needed unless you have a super computer running machine learning or playing the latest games on the highest settings.
reviews.author: Nathan

reviews.title: Style I liked with the function I needed
reviews.comment: If you're ever had your electronics taken out by a lightning strike, you'll understand why I needed a case with a 5.25" bay for a removeable drive enclosure. Now I can make back ups and store the drive somewhere safe. This case has 2 bays, but they are discreetly tucked behind a cover. Fractal has good quality in the build as well. You have a bout an inch of space behind the motherboard tray, so cable management is no issue
reviews.author: D. Norton
